title: Mini convergence: effort scorer & variant list
content:
Sheet: Mini convergence effort scorer & variant list
Generated as an informal, shareable estimate table to guide an ad-hoc cross-functional patch and light telemetry validation. Not final — use for planning and rapid triage only.

Columns: Item | Variant (short) | Primary Owner | Team | Est Effort (hrs) | Confidence (H/M/L) | Impact (Tier) | Blockers | Next action | Linked ticket

1) Prefix cache pressure | cache-soft-limit | Noah Kim | eng-serving-runtime | 6 | M | P2 (throughput) | need sample traces from prod-lab | Pull traces + quick sim run | JIRA-5821
2) Embedding hot-route duplication | embed-dup-guard | Priya Shah | product-ops | 3 | H | P3 (cost) | none | add dedupe flag to route config | JIRA-5899
3) Canary routing misweight | route-weight-fix | Liam O'Neill | platform-engineering | 4 | M | P1 (latency) | flaky metric in staging | adjust canary to 0.2 and remeasure | GH PR 1287
4) KV cache eviction tuning | kv-evict-tune | Zoe Bennett | observability | 5 | L | P2 (latency variance) | need historical eviction hist | export last-30d evict logs | CONFLUENCE mini-dump
5) Dedicated capacity burst policy | burst-policy-clean | Ava Ramirez | product-ops | 8 | M | P1 (SLA) | contract question with infra | align with infra legal + run tabletop | JIRA-5933
6) Telemetry sampling mismatch | telem-sample-align | Noah Kim | eng-serving-runtime | 2 | H | P3 (signal quality) | sampling config diff across regions | standardize 1/100 sampling rate | JIRA-5905
7) Fallback model variant tagging | model-tag-rollout | Priya Shah | product-ops | 3 | M | P2 (reliability) | unclear tag schema | propose tag mapping + small rollout | GH draft 1290
8) Alert noise: duplicate alerts | alert-dedup | Liam O'Neill | site-reliability-engineering | 4 | H | P2 (ops load) | alert ids need consolidation | merge rules + test on staging | JIRA-5948
9) Cost-per-token spike probe | cost-spike-probe | Zoe Bennett | finance-ops | 6 | L | P2 (cost) | sampling window too narrow | expand window to 1h, rerun sample | JIRA-5961
10) Small UX telemetry: streaming drop | ui-stream-loss | Ava Ramirez | product-ux | 2 | H | P3 (customer impact) | repro steps inconsistent | attach network traces + UX repro | CONFLUENCE UX-notes

Quick totals (hand-sum): Estimated hours = 43 hrs across small patches (low-confidence items may double).

Priority guidance (fast triage):
- Immediate (next 48h): items 1,3,5 (latency/SLA facing)
- Short-term (1wk): items 2,6,7,8
- Monitor/analysis (2wk): items 4,9,10

Notes/assumptions:
- Effort estimates are single-owner dev + 1 review, not accounting for multi-team meetings or legal.
- Confidence H/M/L maps roughly to: H = >=80% accurate, M = +-40%, L = exploratory.
- Impact tiers: P1 = user-visible latency/SLA, P2 = cost/throughput variance, P3 = minor cost/UX items.

Open questions (to be resolved in sync):
- Contract/infra constraints for burst capacity (Ava to confirm with infra legal - ETA 2026-07-06).
- Do we have permission to export eviction history from EU region? (Zoe to confirm).
- Which telemetry retention window is canonical for cost analysis? (finance-ops input required).

Next sync: Tue 2026-07-06 10:00am PT (30m) — invite: Ava, Noah, Priya, Liam, Zoe — agenda: lock quick wins, assign owners, export traces for 1/3 items.

Quick todo checklist:
- [ ] Export trace set for prefix cache (Noah)
- [ ] Draft small PR for dedupe flag (Priya)
- [ ] Tabletop conversation with infra legal re: burst (Ava)
- [ ] Consolidate alert IDs and push de-dupe rule (Liam)

Freeform notes / scratch:
- If item 5 requires contract changes, consider 2-step mitigation: reduce burst cap then negotiate.
- For telemetry sampling, unify to 1/100 then evaluate p99 stability.
- Low-effort wins likely to reduce ops pages by ~15% based on past similar work.

References: JIRA-5821, JIRA-5899, JIRA-5905, JIRA-5948, GH PR 1287, GH draft 1290

Created as a lightweight cross-functional estimator for rapid decisioning. Update rows inline as owners confirm times.
